name: Tech-Bank Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Tech-Bank Food Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, operates extensively within the agricultural and animal husbandry sectors, conducting business both domestically in China and internationally. The company's operations are diversified across five principal divisions: Aquatic Feed, Biological Products, Pig-Breeding, Fresh Food, and Engineering Construction. Its Aquatic Feed segment focuses on producing and distributing feed for a wide variety of aquatic animals, including shrimp, crabs, turtles, frogs, and fish, in addition to supplying environmentally friendly food production materials. The Biological Products division is dedicated to developing and providing specialized animal vaccines, such as the pathogenic PRRS cell suspension culture heat-resistant protective agent live vaccine (JAX1-R Strain) and the avian influenza (H9) cell suspension inactivated vaccine, serving the animal health industry, and also offers livestock and poultry products. Tech-Bank Food's Pig-Breeding operations include the provision of genetic products for pigs. Moreover, its Fresh Food segment delivers a diverse array of gourmet items, such as caviars, hairy crabs, crystal shrimps, and yellow croaker products, complemented by its activities in pork and seafood processing. Finally, the Engineering Construction division offers end-to-end services encompassing the planning, design, construction, and management of various projects. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, the company underwent a name change in May 2017, transitioning from its former identity as Ningbo Tech-Bank Co., Ltd. to its current designation, Tech-Bank Food Co., Ltd.
